dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Eq is propositional equality on two values of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the required square-root law exact: for every real x, the natural square of sqrtLike x must equal x.
dependency_coverage.source_match: Exact equality is the expected algebraic law needed for a real p = 1/2 power to act as a square root, so it faithfully states the designated obstruction.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Exists quantifies over a witness satisfying the following predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The negated existential ranges over total functions sqrtLike : Real -> Real; it asks whether one choice works for every real input.
dependency_coverage.source_match: A literal total real-valued interpretation of x^(1/2) on every real input would supply exactly such a function; negating its existence captures the counterexample artifact.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.interpretation: HPow.hPow applies the heterogeneous-power operation selected by its HPow instance to a base and exponent.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With base Real, exponent Nat, and result Real, it elaborates the notation (sqrtLike x) ^ 2.
dependency_coverage.source_match: The source obstruction concerns real exponentiation, and this occurrence is the ordinary natural square used to test the defining law for the half-power specialization.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Monoid.toNatPow equips a monoid with natural-number powers by iterated multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the exponent in the conclusion to ordinary natural squaring in the multiplicative monoid of reals, rather than to an unspecified real-power convention.
dependency_coverage.source_match: Ordinary real squaring is precisely the unambiguous operation used to show that a total real square-root interpretation cannot cover negative values.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Nat is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exponent type for the numeral 2 in the square-law conclusion.
dependency_coverage.source_match: The natural exponent 2 is the reciprocal-law test associated with the source-allowed real order p = 1/2; it does not incorrectly restrict the source order itself to Nat.

dependency_coverage.name: Not
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Not P is defined as P -> False.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It asserts that existence of a total real function satisfying the square law for all real x is impossible.
dependency_coverage.source_match: Nonexistence is the intended form of this DISCREPANCY-row obstruction, rather than a replacement definition of the source moments.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.interpretation: OfNat.ofNat interprets a natural numeral in a type with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It elaborates the written numeral 2 as the natural exponent supplied to HPow.hPow.
dependency_coverage.source_match: The exact exponent 2 correctly expresses the square law required of the p = 1/2 specialization.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both the domain and codomain of sqrtLike, and the universally quantified input x, are Real.
dependency_coverage.source_match: The source explicitly treats X as real-valued and allows negative values by giving no nonnegativity restriction; Real is therefore the exact scalar domain on which the half-power obstruction arises.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.interpretation: Real.instMonoid is the standard multiplicative monoid structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies standard real multiplication to Monoid.toNatPow, so y ^ 2 means the usual real square y * y.
dependency_coverage.source_match: The standard real square is nonnegative and hence cannot equal every real x; this is the intended mathematical obstruction, with no nonstandard power operation hidden in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.interpretation: instHPow turns an ordinary Pow instance into homogeneous HPow, returning the same base type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes Real-by-Nat exponentiation to the standard Pow Real Nat operation and returns a Real.
dependency_coverage.source_match: This confirms that the square-law codomain is real and that the obstruction is not caused by an extended or complex codomain differing from the source's real-valued convention.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.interpretation: instOfNatNat supplies the canonical interpretation of each natural numeral as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the exponent literal exactly the natural number 2.
dependency_coverage.source_match: Using exactly 2 matches the defining square equation for a putative real half-power and introduces no coefficient or indexing discrepancy.

rationale: The target is intentionally an obstruction theorem for a DISCREPANCY row, not the direct Lean definition of moments. The source's literal scope combines a real-valued X with every real p > 0; choosing p = 1/2 exposes the need for a total Real -> Real half-power on arbitrary, including negative, pointwise values. The Lean proposition exactly denies existence of such a function satisfying the standard square law, with all eleven dependencies confirming ordinary real natural squaring and no hidden restriction. In that designated artifact scope both implication directions hold, so the classification is faithful-equivalent and accepted. The judgment does not claim that this theorem encodes expectation, the absolute-moment formula, or the source's separate integrability ambiguity.
